# Lib (lib.tirup.in)

Lib is a components library by Tirup Mehta: unique, self-owned React
components with live playgrounds. Copy the code, own it forever.
Single files, zero third-party dependencies, MIT licensed (free forever).

Author: Tirup Mehta (https://lib.tirup.in)

## Components

### Liquid Ascii (ascii liquid effect)
Free React component that renders a real-time FLIP fluid simulation as
ASCII text on a canvas. Move the cursor through it and the liquid splashes
in characters. FLIP fluid simulation, staggered MAC grid, 30-iteration
pressure solve, PIC/FLIP blend. Theme-aware, reduced-motion safe.
Live demo, props, install command, and build notes:
https://lib.tirup.in/components/liquid-ascii

## Install
npx shadcn@latest add https://lib.tirup.in/r/liquid-ascii.json
Or register once: npx shadcn@latest registry add @mehta=https://lib.tirup.in/r/{name}.json
then: npx shadcn@latest add @mehta/liquid-ascii
